children.value: > Fact From Story: Taylor Swift has revealed when her relationship with Travis Kelce really started.

> > Fact From Story: Speaking to the publication, she said she connected with Kelce in July, after he confessed on his podcast that he tried and failed to give her a friendship bracelet with his phone number on it during one of her Eras Tour shows.

> > > Fact From Story: “By the time I went to that first game, we were a couple. I think some people think that they saw our first date at that game? We would never be psychotic enough to hard launch a first date,” she said.
> > > Fact From Story: “We started hanging out right after that. So we actually had a significant amount of time that no one knew, which I’m grateful for, because we got to get to know each other.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Something that started in July and was kept private would have been revealed later.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: The month of July comes before September.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If a celebrity reveals when a relationship started, that relationship exists/existed.
